target.statement: RGLD mean AUROC of 77.50 across 47 ADBench tabular datasets (single headline number; cheapest meaningful proxy is RGLD's AUROC on one small ADBench dataset, e.g. thyroid or WBC)
target.table_ref: Table 1 (main benchmark); per-dataset AUROC in Table 7
target.dataset: ADBench (47 tabular datasets; smallest e.g. thyroid, WBC, WPBC)

compute.basis: RGLD is a lightweight CPU statistical method (0.22 s avg runtime, no training), but the code is only promised 'upon acceptance' with no link, so an agent must reimplement the full pipeline (QMC random features, multi-scale KDE, sampled-reference kNN, rank aggregation) and download ADBench; reproducing the 47-dataset mean is the real target and requires running all datasets plus 23 baselines.

blockers: No code link in paper; code only promised upon acceptance

title: RGLD: Randomized Global-Local Density Estimation for Tabular Anomaly Detection
